fields.notes: The TileLink Specification 1.7.1 does not specify DFT / scan / BIST / MBIST / boundary scan. The protocol only specifies functional signaling. Concrete TileLink master / slave / crossbar / cache IPs add standard scan insertion + DFT compression + boundary-scan during SoC integration; debug visibility is typically provided via the RISC-V Debug Module, JTAG (IEEE 1149.1), and trace components — all outside the scope of this protocol spec.
protocol_defined_fault_observation: c_error on channel C (master-side): single-bit signal that the master agent was unable to service a request. Sticky-after-rise within a burst.
d_error on channel D (slave-side): single-bit signal that the slave was unable to service a request. Sticky-after-rise within a burst.

evidence.quote: The C and D channels contain a single bit field with which to signal errors. The error field can only be raised HIGH a single time within a burst. Once raise HIGH it must remain HIGH for the duration of the burst.
